$comment: The known-failures catalogue: this index plus one <area>.json per area. Edit the area files, then run scripts/check-catalogue.mjs --write. Never edit the rendered references.
stack: Expo SDK 57 (expo 57.0.27), React Native 0.86.3, React 19.2.3, Xcode 26.6, Android compileSdk and targetSdk 36, Jest 29.7, Maestro 2.10

build.title: Expo config, variants, Metro and native modules
build.intro: Failures while loading app.config.ts, resolving the variant, running config plugins and prebuild, bundling with Metro, and starting native modules, on both platforms.
build.reverify: npx expo config --type public && npx expo export --platform ios --platform android

ios.title: Xcode, xcodebuild and the iOS simulator
ios.intro: Failures while selecting Xcode, prebuilding the iOS project, building for the simulator, and running or screenshotting the app there.

android.title: Gradle, the Android emulator and adb
android.intro: Failures of the JDK and SDK toolchain, Gradle, the emulator, adb installs, APK checks and Android 16 behaviour.

release.title: Signing, store uploads and EAS submit
release.intro: Failures of the signed archive, export, store gate, upload, processing and the store consoles, on the EAS lane and the local lane. Rows marked "needs a human" are stops: send one message and never retry.

deps.title: Dependencies, pinning and knip
deps.intro: Failures while installing, pinning or upgrading packages, held-back majors, install scripts, and knip findings.
deps.reverify: npm ls expo react-native typescript eslint jest && npx expo install --check

lint.title: TypeScript and ESLint
lint.intro: Compiler and lint errors seen with the strict TypeScript 6 setup and the ESLint 9 flat config, and the config bugs found while verifying them.

testing.title: Jest, RNTL, goldens, coverage and Stryker
testing.intro: Failures of unit, component, golden, coverage and mutation tests.

e2e.title: Maestro flows and devices
e2e.intro: Failures of Maestro end-to-end flows on the iOS simulator and the Android emulator, and of the devices they run on.

animation.title: Reanimated, Worklets, Skia and gestures
animation.intro: Failures in frame callbacks, worklets, springs, Skia canvases, frame rates and gestures.

i18n.title: Intl, catalogs, RTL and fonts
i18n.intro: Failures with Intl on Hermes, message catalogs, right-to-left layout and direction switches, and fonts.

services.title: Ads, consent, purchases, audio, haptics and privacy
services.intro: Failures with AdMob and consent (UMP, App Tracking Transparency), store purchases, audio and haptics, and privacy declarations.

state.title: State, persistence, navigation, async and dates
state.intro: Failures with stores, validation, SQLite persistence, navigation, cancellation and day maths.
state.reverify: npm ls zustand expo-sqlite expo-router valibot

gates.title: Quality gates, hooks, commits and agent hooks
gates.intro: Failures of the gates themselves, git hooks, commit rules, reports and Claude Code hooks and settings.

perf.title: Performance and accessibility
perf.intro: Measurement traps, budgets, and accessibility findings on VoiceOver and TalkBack.

parity.title: Visual parity and screenshot comparison
parity.intro: Failures while capturing the app and the design and comparing them element by element: unsettled captures, the wrong device, status bars, modal roots, scroll offsets and comparison traps. design-visual-parity owns the full procedure and its failure-message table.
parity.reverify: maestro --version && xcrun simctl list devicetypes && emulator -version

skills.title: Agent skills that do not load, trigger or run
skills.intro: Symptoms of skills that never load, never trigger or whose scripts misbehave; skill-maintenance owns the full procedure.

games.title: Games (optional plugin)
games.intro: Failures specific to the optional games plugin: deterministic rules, levels, real-time loops, balance simulations and session hosts.

runtime.title: Red boxes, the dev server and the default stack at run time
runtime.intro: Failures while the app runs in development and in production: Metro and the dev server, React red boxes and warnings, Expo Router navigation, network requests, TanStack Query, over-the-air updates, crash reports, secure storage and deep links, on both platforms.
runtime.reverify: npx expo start --help && npm ls react react-native expo-router @tanstack/react-query

bannedTerms.why: house vocabulary: the developer or the reviewer
one app's monorepo workspace path: name the layout key (srcDir, scriptsDir) or src/ instead
an app-specific bundle id or package name: use com.example.tasks
